status.darwin: zenava --version >/dev/null 2>&1; ZENAVA_AUTH=$(find "$HOME/.workbuddy" \( -name binaries -o -name logs -o -name app -o -name cache \) -prune -o -type f -path '*/zenava/scripts/auth_server.py' -print0 2>/dev/null | xargs -0 stat -f '%m %N' 2>/dev/null | sort -nr | awk 'NR==1{ $1=""; sub(/^ /,""); print }'); python "$ZENAVA_AUTH" --status
status.linux: zenava --version >/dev/null 2>&1; ZENAVA_AUTH=$(find "$HOME/.workbuddy" \( -name binaries -o -name logs -o -name app -o -name cache \) -prune -o -type f -path '*/zenava/scripts/auth_server.py' -print0 2>/dev/null | xargs -0 stat -c '%Y %n' 2>/dev/null | sort -nr | awk 'NR==1{ $1=""; sub(/^ /,""); print }'); python "$ZENAVA_AUTH" --status
status.win32: zenava --version >nul 2>&1 & powershell -NoProfile -Command "$root = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.workbuddy'; $skip = @('binaries','logs','app','cache'); $best = $null; $stack = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.Stack[string]; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $root) { $stack.Push($root) }; while ($stack.Count -gt 0) { $dir = $stack.Pop(); try { $entries = [System.IO.Directory]::EnumerateFileSystemEntries($dir) } catch { continue }; foreach ($e in $entries) { if ([System.IO.Directory]::Exists($e)) { if ($skip -notcontains [System.IO.Path]::GetFileName($e)) { $stack.Push($e) } } elseif ([System.IO.Path]::GetFileName($e) -eq 'auth_server.py' -and [System.IO.Path]::GetFileName([System.IO.Path]::GetDirectoryName($e)) -eq 'scripts' -and [System.IO.Path]::GetFileName([System.IO.Path]::GetDirectoryName([System.IO.Path]::GetDirectoryName($e))) -eq 'zenava') { if (-not $best -or [System.IO.File]::GetLastWriteTimeUtc($e) -gt [System.IO.File]::GetLastWriteTimeUtc($best)) { $best = $e } } } }; if (-not $best) { exit 1 }; & python $best --status; exit $LASTEXITCODE"
